about.description: LandX Finance enables fractional ownership and trading of real estate assets through tokenization. It provides institutional-grade real estate exposure via blockchain infrastructure.
about.registryInfo: LandX Finance (BVI / Cayman). Tokenized agricultural-yield protocol launched 2023. Issues commodity-yield tokens (xCORN, xSOY, xWHEAT, xRICE, etc.) representing perpetual cashflows from real farmland production. LNDX governance token.

fees.revenueNotes: LandX earns origination spreads on the perpetual-yield contracts and protocol fees on conversion (xCROP → cash). LNDX captures protocol fees via staking/buyback.
